_doc: Hand-authored prereq edges that don't fall out of concept_edges.json. Pure curriculum sequencing decisions. Direction: A → B means A must be understood before B. Combined with derived edges from concept_edges.json by scripts/derive_prereqs.py.

edges.rationale: preallocate-then-fill sequencing: zeros gives the storage, then slice-view writes into it
broadcasting is taught as a concept first; stride=0 trick is revealed as the impl detail later
linspace-out is the mechanical tool used to build R(u)=O+uD in make_rays_1d; mechanical → conceptual sequencing
curriculum teaches the scalar 2x2 case first, then generalises to batched solve
mesh test exercise pairs them: combine bool masks then call .any() to reduce — but pedagogically introduced together
cache hygiene is paired with device transfer in the GPU notebook
stack/cat appear once repeat is understood — all build batch axes
diagonal is the warmup trick; windowing is the generalisation taught next
kernel shape is introduced after windowing in the conv2d exercise
channel sum follows windowing in the conv2d exercise
output shape formula uses kernel size — taught after kernel-shape
output channel comes from the in-channel sum
padding modifies the output shape formula
stride divides spatial dims in the output shape formula
maxpool reuses the 2d windowing scaffold, replacing einsum with reduce-max
kaiming variance is derived assuming ReLU non-linearity
init runs inside Module __init__
BN is a composed Module
affine params taught first as the trainable bit of BN, then running stats as eval-time book-keeping
running stats are used in eval mode, batch stats in train mode
stem precedes block groups in ResNet construction
training loop toggles model.train()/eval() at boundaries
ResNet stacks blocks via Sequential
custom Tensor wraps an ndarray; basic ndarray fluency first
global flag is checked when wrapping ops on the custom Tensor
requires_grad propagates through the wrapped Tensor
is-differentiable flag is set on the wrapped Tensor
Recipe is stored on the wrapped Tensor
signature encodes the rule
wrapper warns when wrapped op mutates in-place — taught alongside the wrapper
generator block stacks convT-bn-activation; conv basics first
design rule taught alongside Module subclassing
VAE bottleneck is a Linear projection between encoder and decoder — composes inside a Module
VAE recon loss is MSE; loss.backward() pattern first
GAN losses are BCE; loss.backward() pattern first
process group is set up before any device-side comm
leaf assert guards .grad access
repr polish after class hierarchy exists
translating optimizer pseudocode is the meta-skill the exercises drill
constructor accepts list or groups — taught after Parameter
step iterates groups then params within each group
Adam adds v_t on squared grads after m_t — m before v in curriculum
alternative-to siblings share the same windowing scaffold; teach max first then introduce avg
alternative-to siblings; teach bool-mask combination first then introduce int-tensor indexing
non-diff wrap is the simpler sibling of the generic wrapper; introduced together
register_buffer is the non-trainable sibling of nn.Parameter; taught alongside Parameter
torch.where is the branching twin of mask-assignment; taught after inf-mask trick
